permsText.HardDeletionSetting.ReadWrite.Enable: Allows the app to enable hard deletion protection settings on users, applications, groups, and service principals without a signed-in user. Requires Global Administrator or Backup Administrator role.
permsText.ResourcePolicyAssignment.Read.All: Allows the app to read all resource policy assignments, without a signed-in user.
permsText.ResourcePolicyAssignment.ReadWrite.All: Allows the app to read and write all resource policy assignments, without a signed-in user.
permsText.ResourcePolicyConfiguration.Read.All: Allows the app to read the tenant-wide resource policy configuration, including the configured privileged-read app ID, without a signed-in user.
permsText.ResourcePolicyConfiguration.ReadWrite.Al: Allows the app to read and write the tenant-wide resource policy configuration, including setting the privileged-read app ID used by all fetch() calls during policy evaluation, without a signed-in user.
permsText.ResourcePolicyDefinition.Read.All: Allows the app to read all resource policy definitions, without a signed-in user.
permsText.ResourcePolicyDefinition.ReadWrite.All: Allows the app to read and write all resource policy definitions, without a signed-in user.
permsText.ResourcePolicyEvaluation.Read.All: Allows the app to evaluate resource policies, without a signed-in user.
